description: Select a lightweight soft blend over cached top-K expert candidates.
notes: Train on validation cache and evaluate once on test cache per dataset/seed.
Candidate set is the union of M7, R1, and R1-plus top-K items.
This is the first V2 router baseline; it does not retrain expert recommenders.
Use a coarse 0.2 soft-blend grid for the first full-dataset run, then refine around promising regions if needed.
